response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates exceptional general software engineering expertise with 15+ years of experience, this role requires native Japanese language proficiency—a hard requirement completely absent from his resume. Additionally, his career trajectory centers on web and full-stack development, not embedded systems security. The role demands deep expertise in embedded LAN-switch security (MACsec, 802.1X, kernel analysis) and networking protocols, none of which appear in his background. His C experience is outdated (last used 2014-2015), and there is no evidence of Linux kernel source-code analysis or modification capabilities.
strengths: 15+ years of proven software development experience across diverse domains demonstrates strong engineering fundamentals and rapid learning ability
Experience architecting low-latency, high-performance systems at Dunnhumby and working on hardware control (robotic arms, device orchestration) shows capability for complex technical work
Track record of mentoring, knowledge-sharing, and shipping products to scale suggests maturity and practical problem-solving skills
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency listed—a stated required qualification that is completely missing from the resume
Career has diverged away from embedded systems toward web/SaaS/backend development; limited recent embedded systems experience (none after ~2016)
No demonstrated expertise in security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption, tamper detection), networking protocols (NETCONF, SNMP, Telemetry), or Linux kernel analysis—all core to this role

key_factors.factor: No embedded systems security or networking specialization
Demonstrated software engineering excellence and adaptability
